name: summable_of_sum_range_le
result.signature: {f : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hf : ∀ n, 0 ≤ f n) (h : ∀ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i ≤ c) : Summable f
result.type: ∀ {f : ℕ → ℝ} {c : ℝ}, (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ f n) → (∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i ≤ c) → Summable f
result.value:
:= by
  refine (summable_iff_not_tendsto_nat_atTop_of_nonneg hf).2 fun H => ?_
  rcases exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop H 0 c with ⟨n, -, hn⟩
  exact lt_irrefl _ (hn.trans_le (h n))
result.informal_name: Summability Criterion for Non-Negative Real Series with Bounded Partial Sums
result.informal_description: For a non-negative real sequence $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R} $, if there exists a real constant $ c $ such that for all $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, the partial sum $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) \leq c $, then the infinite series $ \sum_{n=0}^\infty f(n) $ is summable (converges) in the real numbers.

result.type: ∀ {f : ℕ → NNReal} {c : NNReal}, (∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i ≤ c) → Summable f
result.value:
:= by
  refine summable_iff_not_tendsto_nat_atTop.2 fun H => ?_
  rcases exists_lt_of_tendsto_atTop H 0 c with ⟨n, -, hn⟩
  exact lt_irrefl _ (hn.trans_le (h n))
result.informal_name: Non-Negative Series with Bounded Partial Sums are Summable
result.informal_description: For any function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $ and any non-negative real number $ c $, if for every natural number $ n $ the sum $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) \leq c $, then the infinite series $ \sum_{k=0}^\infty f(k) $ is summable.

name: NNReal
tsum_le_of_sum_range_le
result.signature: {f : ℕ → ℝ≥0} {c : ℝ≥0} (h : ∀ n, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i ≤ c) : ∑' n, f n ≤ c
result.type: ∀ {f : ℕ → NNReal} {c : NNReal}, (∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i ≤ c) → ∑' (n : ℕ), f n ≤ c
result.informal_name: Infinite Sum Bounded by Partial Sums in Non-negative Reals
result.informal_description: For any sequence $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $ and any $ c \in \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $, if every partial sum $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) $ over the first $ n $ terms satisfies $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) \leq c $, then the infinite sum $ \sum_{n=0}^{\infty} f(n) $ converges to a value $ \leq c $ in the topological space of non-negative real numbers.

name: summable_of_sum_le
result.signature: {ι : Type*} {f : ι → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hf : 0 ≤ f) (h : ∀ u : Finset ι, ∑ x ∈ u, f x ≤ c) : Summable f
result.type: ∀ {ι : Type u_3} {f : ι → ℝ} {c : ℝ}, 0 ≤ f → (∀ (u : Finset ι), ∑ x ∈ u, f x ≤ c) → Summable f
result.value:
:=
  ⟨⨆ u : Finset ι, ∑ x ∈ u, f x, tendsto_atTop_ciSup (Finset.sum_mono_set_of_nonneg hf) ⟨c, fun _ ⟨u, hu⟩ => hu ▸ h u⟩⟩
result.informal_name: Summability Criterion for Non-Negative Real-Valued Functions with Bounded Partial Sums
result.informal_description: For any index set $\iota$ and a non-negative function $f : \iota \to \mathbb{R}$, if there exists a real number $c$ such that the sum of $f$ over every finite subset of $\iota$ is bounded above by $c$, then the infinite series $\sum_{b \in \iota} f(b)$ is summable in $\mathbb{R}$.

name: NNReal
summable_iff_not_tendsto_nat_atTop
result.signature: {f : ℕ → ℝ≥0} : Summable f ↔ ¬Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) atTop atTop
result.type: ∀ {f : ℕ → NNReal}, Summable f ↔ ¬Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, f i) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
result.informal_name: Summable iff Partial Sums Do Not Tend to Infinity in Non-negative Reals
result.informal_description: A sequence $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $ is summable if and only if the sequence of its partial sums $ \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} f(i) $ does not tend to infinity as $ n $ approaches infinity.

result.informal_description: For any positive integer $a$ and natural numbers $k, n$, the number of integers $x$ in the half-open interval $[k, k + n)$ satisfying $\gcd(a, x) = 1$ is at most $\varphi(a) \cdot \left(\left\lfloor \frac{n}{a} \right\rfloor + 1\right)$, where $\varphi$ denotes Euler's totient function.
